blocks.text: Actor So Ji Sub has announced an upcoming meeting with his global fans. His agency 51K stated, “So Ji Sub will hold 2026 SO JI SUB ASIA FANMEETING TOUR [Soulmate The Timeless], visiting 5 cities across Asia including Manila on November 5 at the New Frontier Theater. ‘Soulmate The Timeless’ carries the meaning of wanting to remain together, unchanged through time, with the fans who have long supported So Ji Sub. He plans to create special memories by closely connecting with fans — sharing moments from his works, behind-the-scenes stories, and a variety of stage performances.
